_comment: Per-boat source overrides: boats whose workbook link is a search page or brand homepage pull photos/description from the manufacturer's model page instead. official:true relabels the VDP outbound link as the brand model page. primaryPhoto:N promotes photo N to the front when the source page leads with a schematic, a trailer close-up or a dark render. photoFallback {url,token,credit} tops up a thin gallery from the manufacturer's model page; token must appear in the filename so another model's hero shot cannot land on this boat. exclude:true drops the boat from the site entirely (no detail page, no sitemap entry, no listing) for boats the dealer has confirmed are NOT coming to the show; excludeReason records why. Excluded boats keep their photo files on disk so the exclusion can be reversed by deleting the entry. Applied by scripts/import-show-boats.mjs after parsing; survives daily syncs.

boston-whaler-220-dauntless.blurb: The 220 Dauntless is Boston Whaler's do-anything 22-footer: the unsinkable hull the brand is famous for, a fishing-ready cockpit, and comfortable bow seating that turns the same boat into a family cruiser by afternoon.

boston-whaler-280-vantage.blurb: The 280 Vantage is Boston Whaler's versatile dual console: one side console, one comfortable port lounge, and a layout that moves easily between fishing, cruising, and watersports, all on Whaler's unsinkable foundation.

boston-whaler-330-outrage.blurb: The 330 Outrage is the newest boat in Boston Whaler's flagship offshore line: a center console built on Whaler's famously unsinkable hull, with a deep protected cockpit, serious fishing capability, and family comfort throughout. Atlantic City is its first New Jersey boat show, presented on the water by Comstock and MarineMax.

cobia-245-cc.blurb: The 245 CC is Cobia's newest center console, built on the brand's dry ride hull with a 20 degree deadrise and Seakeeper Ride trim control as standard. It is rated for up to 350 horsepower. A tuna door, tackle storage and livewell handle the fishing; fold-down transom seating, a forward-opening console head and a removable bow insert handle the rest.

crownline-298-xss.blurb: The 298 XSS is the single engine side of Crownline's pointed-nose XSS outboard line, a bowrider built for entertaining. A 23 degree deadrise hull runs on single Mercury outboard power, and the deck carries electric sun lounge seating, a powered swim step with boarding assist, twin Garmin screens and Wet Sounds audio.

crownline-318-xss.blurb: The 318 XSS is the twin engine end of Crownline's pointed-nose XSS outboard line, built for long days with a crowd. Twin Mercury power, joystick piloting and an optional bow thruster handle close quarters, under a redesigned aluminum hard top with electric SureShade. Windlass and an electric flush head are standard.

cutwater-248.blurb: The Cutwater 248 is a single engine Downeast style cruiser, powered by a Yamaha F250 on a double-stepped hull with Laminar Flow Interrupters. Below are a private forward stateroom, a convertible dinette, a galley and an enclosed head. An opening aft bulkhead window turns the dinette into rear-facing cockpit seating.

cutwater-288.blurb: The Cutwater 288 carries twin Yamaha F250 outboards on a double-stepped deep-V hull with a stout 10 foot beam, and stays trailerable. Accommodation for six runs from a forward stateroom to a mid-berth and a private head with shower, with a full galley in the salon and rod holders, a livewell and a grill in the cockpit.

everglades-315-cc.blurb: The 315 CC is Everglades' 31-foot offshore center console, built on a variable deadrise deep V hull with patented RAMCAP closed-mold construction and structural foam flotation. The single-level cockpit gives 360 degree gunnel access, with split bow seating, aft mezzanine seating and a console head compartment.

everglades-375-cc.blurb: The 375 CC is Everglades' 37-foot offshore center console, and the one whose console opens into an enclosed cabin: L-shaped seating that converts to a twin berth, plus a head with shower. On deck it keeps the single-level cockpit and mezzanine seating, with twin or triple outboard power.

finseeker-260-dual-console.blurb: The Finseeker 260 is a 26-foot dual console from Crownline's fishing-focused line, pairing genuine fishing features with the seating and comfort of a family day boat.

formula-360-cbr.blurb: The Formula 360 Crossover Bowrider does two jobs without compromise: open-bow day boating and genuine performance cruising, with overnight-capable cabin space below and Formula's signature build quality throughout.

godfrey-pontoons-monaco-mc-255-sdb-slide.blurb: The Monaco MC 255 SDB Slide is Godfrey's double decker Sundeck layout: an upper deck with a non-slip sunpad and water slide sitting above a walk-through lower deck. Below, the Sundeck Bar plan centers on a high-top table with four bar stools. It runs 25 feet 9 inches overall and takes up to 400 horsepower.

godfrey-pontoons-sweetwater-sw-2286-dt.blurb: The Sweetwater SW 2286 DT takes the Entertainment layout in the dinette direction: a large table with countertop space and two flip loungers beside it. Pull the table out and lay the loungers flat, and the deck opens into one broad lounging area. It measures 23 feet 10 inches and carries up to 12 passengers.

godfrey-pontoons-sweetwater-sw-2286-mt.blurb: The Sweetwater SW 2286 MT is the mid-table take on Godfrey's Entertainment layout: bow benches forward and a midship table ringed by four bar stools, keeping dining and conversation in the middle of the boat. It runs 23 feet 10 inches, carries up to 12 people and is rated to 300 horsepower.

godfrey-pontoons-sweetwater-sw-2286-sb.blurb: The Sweetwater SW 2286 SB runs Godfrey's Split Bench floorplan: benches in the bow and benches at the stern with a center walk-through between them, plenty of under-seat storage and easy movement end to end. It measures 23 feet 10 inches and seats up to 16.

godfrey-pontoons-sweetwater-sw-2286-sfl.blurb: The Sweetwater SW 2286 SFL is the Lounge layout, built around a single flip lounge at the stern. The adjustable backrest faces forward for conversation, aft for the view, or lies flat as a sunbed, with two bench seats up in the bow. It runs 23 feet 10 inches and up to 300 horsepower.

godfrey-pontoons-xperience-ex-2286-sbx.blurb: The Xperience EX 2286 SBX puts the Split Bench floorplan on Godfrey's most pared-back series: two bow benches, two aft benches, a center walk-through and under-seat storage, with the essentials fitted and the extras left off. It measures 23 feet 10 inches and takes up to 300 horsepower.

hurricane-deck-sd-2400-ob.blurb: The SD 2400 OB is Hurricane's 24 foot SunDeck outboard, an open-layout deck boat aimed squarely at cruising and entertaining. It carries 12 people behind a full wrap-around windshield, with an integrated swim platform, bow and stern telescoping ladders and under-deck storage keeping the cockpit clear.

hurricane-deck-sundeck-217-ob.blurb: The SunDeck 217 OB fits a 14 person capacity into 21 feet 5 inches, which makes it the compact entertainer of Hurricane's SunDeck outboard range. Rated for 150 to 225 horsepower, it carries the series essentials: a full wrap-around windshield, integrated swim platform and telescoping ladders fore and aft.

hurricane-deck-sundeck-235-ob.blurb: The SunDeck 235 OB stretches to 23 feet 4 inches and seats 12. It is one of only two SunDeck models offered with Hurricane's adjustable captain's seat: fold the backrest down when the helm is not in use and the stern bench extends, turning the driving position into more lounge space.

hurricane-deck-sundeck-2486-ob.blurb: The SunDeck 2486 OB matches the 2400 OB for length at 24 feet but is set up to carry 14 rather than 12, with convertible bow and stern seating that switches between running and lounging. An enclosed head with sink and a full wrap-around windshield support genuinely long days aboard.

hurricane-deck-sundeck-2600-ob.blurb: The SunDeck 2600 OB is the yacht certified end of the range at 26 feet 5 inches, taking 250 to 400 horsepower for bigger water and longer runs. Standard kit runs to a full wrap-around windshield, enclosed head with sink, full swim platform and fresh water washdown, with a windlass anchor optional.

key-west-249-fs.blurb: The Key West 249FS is a family sportsman that splits its time honestly: a fishing-first hull and cockpit with the bow seating and comfort that keep the whole crew aboard for the rest of the day.

monterey-34-elite.blurb: The Elite 34 is the next evolution of Monterey's award-winning Elite Series: an upper-premium outboard model with expanded entertaining space, elevated helm ergonomics, and extended offshore capability, launching in Summer 2026. See it make its debut on the water in Atlantic City with Coty Marine.

navan-t-30-center-console.blurb: The Navan T30 is a Scandinavian-designed 30-foot adventure center console: deep protected seating, smart all-weather ergonomics, and twin Mercury outboards, built for running hard in real conditions.

parker-180-coastal-edition.blurb: The 180 Coastal Edition is the smallest boat in Parker's Coastal line, built on the shallow draft Modified-V hull that suits inshore fishing and easy days on the water. A flush deck bow, self bailing cockpit, 17.5 gallon insulated livewell, eight gunwale rod holders and a swim platform with retractable ladder are standard.

parker-210-coastal.excludeReason: NOT AT SHOW - omitted from New Jersey Outboards' complete at-show lineup (Glenn Gioe stock list, Aug 27). Was live and crawlable until Aug 30.

parker-2100-se-cc.blurb: The 2100 SE CC is Parker's 21 foot Special Edition center console, built on a shallow draft Modified-V hull for a day of inshore fishing or an afternoon at the sandbar. It comes standard with a flush deck bow for open fishing space, with a forward platform, storage and removable cushion offered as an option.

parker-227-explorer.blurb: The 227 Explorer is the compact end of Parker's Explorer range, a composite Sport Cabin for anglers and recreational boaters. A pilothouse shelters the helm, a twin berth sits forward, and the Seakeeper 450 Ride system is standard. It is rated to 300 horsepower and carries 105 gallons of fuel.

parker-230-coastal-edition.blurb: The 230 Coastal Edition is a 23 foot center console on Parker's shallow draft Modified-V hull, balancing inshore fishing against relaxed sandbar days. It carries a fiberglass hardtop with four rod rocket launcher, Wet Sounds stereo, trim tabs, eight gunwale rod holders and a livewell in the forward console seat.

parker-247-explorer.blurb: The 247 Explorer steps up from the 227 with more range and fishing capacity: 141 gallons of fuel, a 400 horsepower rating, two in floor fish boxes with macerator and a windlass with 300 feet of rode. The cabin holds a twin berth with porta potty, and Seakeeper 450 Ride is standard.

parker-257-explorer.blurb: The 257 Explorer widens the Explorer hull to a 9 foot 7 inch beam and adds a fully enclosed cabin with twin berths, 76 inches of pilothouse headroom and an electric head with holding tank. Rated to 500 horsepower with 179 gallons of fuel, it is built for serious anglers and carries up to 12.

parker-287-explorer.blurb: The 287 Explorer is the largest boat in Parker's Explorer line at 27 feet 9 inches, rated to 700 horsepower with 232 gallons of fuel. It steps up to the Seakeeper 525 Ride system and offers 77 inches of pilothouse headroom, twin berths and an electric head, with a Garmin plotter and Wet Sounds stereo standard.

pursuit-s-288.blurb: The S 288 is Pursuit's compact sport center console: 30'0" length overall with a 9'8" beam, twin Yamaha outboards up to 600 hp, and a deep 24-degree transom deadrise for offshore work. The layout fits generous bow and aft seating, big stowage, and a sizable console with a step-down head, backed by 230 gallons of fuel and Pursuit's signature fit and finish.

regulator-31.blurb: The Regulator 31 is a serious offshore center console with the deep-V Carolina ride Regulator is known for, twin Yamaha outboard power, and a tournament-grade fishing cockpit finished to yacht standards.

regulator-35.blurb: The Regulator 35 is the biggest boat Regulator builds: a canyon-running center console with Yamaha outboard power, massive fuel and fish capacity, and the legendary Carolina-flared ride that made the brand.

robalo-230-center-console.blurb: The Robalo 230 Center Console is built around the Hydro Lift multi-angle hull design, pairing a serious offshore ride with a working fishing deck. Horizontal tubed rod storage, a 25 gallon live well and SeaStar tilt hydraulic steering are standard, with a telescopic ladder and grab handle on the swim platform.

robalo-257-dual-console.blurb: The Robalo 257 Dual Console is a do-it-all 25 footer, with comfortable seating from bow to stern and deep storage compartments for long days exploring. Anglers get twin 50 gallon fish boxes and a 30 gallon aft livewell, under an oversized hardtop whose D-shaped frame clears the captain's sightlines.

robalo-300-center-console.blurb: The Robalo 300 Center Console balances comfort and offshore performance on a Michael Peters-designed hull, at home either trolling with hooks in the water or running rough seas after a trophy catch. A triple-wide helm stand, an oversized hardtop with a skylight and a freshwater shower are among the highlights.

sea-hunt-ultra-234.blurb: The Ultra 234 is Sea Hunt's 23'7" single-engine center console, rigged as standard with a Yamaha F200, hydraulic steering and a 9" Garmin GPSMAP at the helm. Bow backrests, bolsters and cushions wrap the forward seating, while T-top, bait tank and mezzanine leaning post options tilt it toward fishing.

sea-hunt-ultra-265-se.excludeReason: NOT AT SHOW - omitted from New Jersey Outboards' complete at-show lineup (Glenn Gioe stock list, Aug 27). Was live and crawlable until Aug 30.

sea-hunt-ultra-305-se.blurb: The Ultra 305 SE sits at the top of Sea Hunt's Ultra range at 30'2", standard with twin Yamaha F300s, electric steering, Yamaha autopilot and dual 17" Garmin displays. An entertainment leaning post, telescoping bow table, dual side entry doors and a console head point it at long days offshore with company aboard.

sea-pro-225-flxr.blurb: The 225 FLXR is Sea Pro's smaller sandbar boat: a removable stern sandbar table, a reversible leaning post, stern bench seating with reversible backrests and bow seating for a day anchored up. It draws 14 inches, carries nine and takes up to 250 horsepower. The R designates Seakeeper Ride in place of trim tabs.

sea-pro-245-flxr.blurb: The 245 FLXR is the bigger sandbar boat in the range, with a removable bow table as well as the stern one, rotating captain's chairs, capacity rated for eleven and up to 350 horsepower. It is a 245 FLX fitted with Seakeeper Ride, which Sea Pro says removes up to 70 percent of pitch and roll.

sea-pro-262-dlx.blurb: The 262 DLX is Sea Pro's 26-foot offshore center console in its upper trim, hand laid over 22.5 degrees of transom deadrise with 153 gallons of fuel and up to 500 horsepower. Against the Sport it adds digital switching, a premium fiberglass leaning post with tackle storage, a bait prep station with sink and a folding stern bench.

solara-310-cw.excludeReason: NOT AT SHOW - omitted from Clarks Landing's own complete at-show lineup (master workbook STATUS, Aug 30). Was live and crawlable until Aug 30.

starcraft-deck-svx-191-ob.blurb: The SVX 191 OB is the compact family deck boat in Starcraft's SVX outboard range, built on the Di-Hedral Vee hull for a drier ride in chop. It runs 18 feet 11 inches on a 102 inch beam, carries up to 12 people and rates to 175 hp. Bimini, four speaker stereo and EVA soft touch matting are standard.

starcraft-deck-svx-211-ob.blurb: The SVX 211 OB is the mid size boat in Starcraft's SVX outboard deck range, stretching the same open floor plan to 20 feet 9 inches. Against the 191 it gains room for 14 people and a 200 hp rating, on the same 102 inch beam and 14 degree transom deadrise. Made for cruising, watersports and sand bar afternoons.

starcraft-deck-svx-230-dc-ob.blurb: The SVX 230 DC OB is the largest boat in Starcraft's SVX outboard deck range, and a dual console: Starcraft pairs a full wrap around windshield with a deep 37 inch cockpit. It measures 22 feet 8 inches on a 102 inch beam, seats 14, holds 60 gallons of fuel and rates to a 300 hp maximum.

tiara-yachts-39ls.blurb: The 39 LS is Tiara's luxury sport day yacht: outboard power, a wide-open social cockpit with seating that converts around an outdoor galley, and the fit and finish Tiara has built its name on. It makes its New Jersey boat show debut in Atlantic City.

tidewater-210-cc-adventure.blurb: The 210 CC Adventure is the compact end of TideWater's CC Adventure line: a 20 foot 10 inch center console rated for eight people and up to 200 horsepower. A 17 degree hull, 26 gallon insulated livewell, fiberglass T-top with glass enclosure and fold-down rear seat cover fishing and family days alike.

tidewater-220-cc-adventure.blurb: The 220 CC Adventure steps up from the 210 with a wider 8 foot 10 inch beam, an 18 degree hull and capacity for ten. Fuel rises to 71 gallons and the rating to 250 horsepower. Standard kit runs to a fiberglass T-top with glass enclosure, trim tabs, a 26 gallon insulated livewell and a fold-down rear seat.

tidewater-232-cc-adventure.blurb: The 232 CC Adventure carries a 20 degree hull, 95 gallons of fuel and a 300 horsepower rating, with room for ten. SeaKeeper Ride stabilization, a recessed windlass with 200 feet of rode and a 30 gallon insulated livewell are standard, and the fold-down rear seat opens the cockpit up for fishing.

tidewater-232-lxf.blurb: The 232 LXF shares the 23 foot 8 inch hull, 20 degree deadrise and 300 horsepower rating of the 232 CC Adventure, but sits in TideWater's LXF line, pitched as luxury and versatility for the whole family. A fixed stern bench seat and insulated stern cooler replace the center console's fold-down rear seat.

tidewater-256-cc-adventure.blurb: The 256 CC Adventure moves into twin outboard territory: a 21 degree hull, 141 gallons of fuel, a 400 horsepower rating and capacity for twelve. Inside the console sits a china head with pump-out and a fresh water shower. A dive door, 30 gallon insulated livewell and fold-down rear seat handle the fishing.

tidewater-256-lxf.blurb: The 256 LXF is the family-leaning trim of TideWater's 25 foot 8 inch, 21 degree hull. Against the 256 CC Adventure it swaps the fold-down rear seat for a fixed stern bench and runs a smaller 19 gallon port stern livewell, while keeping the console head, dive door and 400 horsepower twin outboard rating.

tidewater-272-cc-adventure.blurb: The 272 CC Adventure is yacht certified, built on a 21 degree hull with 178 gallons of fuel and a 500 horsepower rating. Yamaha digital steering, SeaKeeper Ride, a 28 gallon insulated livewell and a console head with fresh water shower are standard. The fold-down rear seat and dive door keep the cockpit working.

tidewater-272-lxf.blurb: The 272 LXF takes the same yacht certified 27 foot 2 inch hull as the 272 CC Adventure and trims it toward comfort. A fixed stern bench seat replaces the fold-down rear seat, while the electric bow table and filler cushion turn the foredeck into a lounge. The console head and dive door stay standard.

tidewater-282-cc-adventure.blurb: The 282 CC Adventure runs a 22 degree hull, 205 gallons of fuel and a 600 horsepower rating. Dual dive doors, recessed rod racks, a tackle center leaning post with sink and insulated aquarium livewells make it a serious fishing platform, while fixed fiberglass bow seating and an electric bow table seat the family.

tidewater-302-cc-adventure.blurb: The 302 CC Adventure is yacht certified on a 22 degree hull, with 230 gallons of fuel and a 700 horsepower rating. Wrap-around bow seating, a console lounge seat with armrests and a flush mount transom seat sit alongside an aquarium livewell leaning post, recessed rod racks and a macerated coffin box.

world-cat-265-dual-console.blurb: The 265 Dual Console is World Cat's mid-size twin hull catamaran, built around stability, safety and performance for a day of fishing or family cruising. Standard equipment runs to a windlass with rode, a 30 gallon lighted livewell, a stand-up head with holding tank, a Corian bar and prep center with tackle storage. Seats up to 12.
